<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.53.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [feat] Move the isolate_styles param in CCv2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13518
* [feat] Rename some external CCv2 types by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13515
### New Features 🎉
* Support for markdown in the metrics value and delta parameters by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13094
* Make Default Sidebar Width Configurable by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12154
* [feat] Update chat input UI with improved layout and styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13088
* Add support for setting metric delta colors from color palette by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13153
* Support configuring the `format` in `st.metric` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13193
* Support for markdown in select_slider options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12960
* Navigate to home page on logo click by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13222
* Add max_upload_size parameter to file_uploader and chat_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12816
* Allow only adding or deleting rows in `st.data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13228
* Add `icon_position` support for button-like components by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13150
* [feat] Add headingFontSize1-6 and headingFontWeight1-6 CSS Custom Properties by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13268
* [feat] Enhance `st.chat_input` file upload UI with improved file chips and retry functionality by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13223
* Add icon support to dialogs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13244
* Allow dynamic changes to selectbox options when `key` is provided by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13383
* Add path tooltip on `st.json` value click by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13113
* Support passing list of pydantic objects as dataframe-like structure by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13348
* [feat] Update AGENTS rules for better a11y practices by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13411
* [feat] Update eslint rules for better a11y support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13412
* Expose OIDC tokens by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12044
* Support pre-defined formats in `format` of `st.slider` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13392
* Add on_release to st.cache_resource. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13439
* Add gaps and sizes for xxsmall, xsmall, xlarge, xxlarge in st.container/columns/space by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13345
* Add new session_duration_seconds_total stats by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13414
* Add session scoping to caches. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13482
* [feat] Simplify chat input UI with single-row layout for basic configurations by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13364
* Add session-scoped connection support. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13506
* [feat] Allow for optional js, css, and html params in CCv2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13511
* Allow dynamically changing in min, max and step in `st.number_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13512
* Add optional support for running Streamlit with Starlette by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13375
* Add SnowflakeCallersRightsConnection. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13538
* Allow dynamic changes to multiselect options when `key` is provided by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13448
* fix(multiselect): preserve scroll position when removing items by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13384
* Add experimental ASGI app entry point for advanced server configuration by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13537
* Allow OAuth redirect_uri to reference current port by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12251
* Make st.logout use end_session_endpoint if provided in OIDC config (V2) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12693
* [feat] Add dynamic layout switching for `st.chat_input`  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13546
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] improve width/height error message to say "positive integer" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13206
* Fix unexpected shrinking of logo with top nav by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13226
* [fix] Do not render sidebar nav when top nav enabled by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13227
* Implement transient spinners by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12826
* [fix] Include default in key for CCv2 instances by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13266
* [fix] Ensure key down targeting works for elements in Shadow DOM by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13264
* Fix data editor regression when starting from empty column by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13309
* Prevent `st.dialog` from showing elements from previous dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13297
* Fix auth-related issues caused by dependency updates by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13333
* [Fix] Theme preference persistence across reloads by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13306
* [fix] Handle undefined theme properties in CCv2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13240
* [fix] Ensure crossOrigin attribute is properly set for CCv2 stylesheets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13376
* Fix the spinner time text alignment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13388
* [fix] tooltip text leaking with newlines in help by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13365
* [fix] Ensure anchor links in Markdown headers are accessible from keyboard by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13378
* [fix] Ensure help Tooltips are accessible by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13379
* [Fix] `st.html` handles list indentation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13437
* [Fix] `st.selectbox` set via session state does not restore initial value by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13438
* [Fix] Altair charts with vconcat and hconcat  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13423
* Fix custom theme when embedded with embed_options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13498
* Improve `st.number_input` precision by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13484
* Add ability to clear transient nodes when the script is run by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13166
* [fix] Correct justifyContents to justifyContent in Icon styled-components by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13557
* [fix] Fix upload button functionality after drag-drop and delete in `st.chat_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13556
### Other Changes
* [chore] Release v1.52.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13186
* [chore] Release v1.52.1 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13235
* [Fix] Theme hashing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13173
* Use the correct snowflake.com domains by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13363
* [chore] Release v1.52.2 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13390
* [polish] Update chat input file chip border radius to match Figma by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13532
* [Fix] Consolidate border/hover colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13536
* [feat] Replace inline error messages with tooltips in `st.chat_input` file upload UI by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13542
* [fix] Update ghost button colors for `st.chat_input` buttons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13535
* [fix] Improve `st.chat_input` file delete button colors by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13554
* [polish] Replace Mic icon with MicNone icon in `st.chat_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13553
* [fix] Shorten `st.chat_input` file chip display to adhere to designs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13555
* [feat] Add image thumbnails to `st.chat_input` file uploads by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13547
